verdict.rationale: The plugin catalog and plugin sources are publicly readable on GitHub (github.com/openai/plugins with plugin folders, a marketplace.json fetched keylessly, and the openai/skills repo), and a probe confirmed the skill folders are plain portable files that third-party tooling can install. However, nothing in the pack states that any of this is under an open license, and the plugin runtime and hosting surfaces are not shown as open source. Missing for 10: any evidence of an OSI/open license on the repos, open source for the Codex plugin runtime/marketplace infrastructure, independent corroboration of licensing terms.
